paper.title: Essentially No Energy Barrier Between Independent Fermionic Neural Quantum State Minima

results.system_description: 2D quantum dot: 6 electrons (6 up, 0 down) in a harmonic trap, omega = 0.0625 (Hartree units), Coulomb repulsion
results.eligibility_evidence: Energy of the trained network 'inferred using fresh test walkers never seen during training' (caption).
results.notes: The paper's Hamiltonian H = -1/2 sum nabla^2 + sum C/r_ij + 1/2 sum r^2 with C = 4, spin-polarized, six electrons in 2D, is in oscillator units. Scaling lengths by 1/sqrt(omega) maps the Hartree-unit dot at omega = 1/C^2 = 0.0625 onto it, with E(Hartree) = omega E(oscillator units); the convention_factor 0.0625 converts the printed energy. The variance var(H) is printed as 0.000210(28) Ha^2 in the same units. Two independent minima of the same network; 1,586,182 parameters.
